table.name: airlines
table.purpose: Lookup table of US airlines; one row per airline, referenced by flights via uid.

Abbreviation.name: Airline short name / brand abbreviation
Abbreviation.description: Short marketing name of the airline (e.g. 'USAir', 'JetBlue', 'Southwest'). Unique per row.

Airline.name: Airline full legal name
Airline.description: Full airline company name (e.g. 'US Airways', 'JetBlue Airways').

Country.name: Airline country
Country.description: Country of the airline; constant 'USA' for all 12 rows.

uid.name: Airline ID (primary key)
uid.description: Surrogate primary key, integers 1-12, referenced by flights.Airline.

table.name: airports
table.purpose: Lookup table of US airports; one row per airport, referenced by flights source/destination codes.

AirportCode.name: IATA airport code (primary key)
AirportCode.description: Three-letter airport code (e.g. 'APN', 'ABQ'), primary key, referenced by flights.SourceAirport and flights.DestAirport.

AirportName.name: Airport name
AirportName.description: Human-readable airport name (e.g. 'Alpena County Regional'). Values have trailing spaces; 'Municipal' appears 12 times, likely truncated names.

City.name: City
City.description: City where the airport is located (trailing spaces present).

Country.name: Country
Country.description: Country name; constant 'United States' for all rows.

CountryAbbrev.name: Country abbreviation
CountryAbbrev.description: Two-letter country code, 'US' (one row has trailing space 'US ').

table.name: flights
table.purpose: Flight schedule/roster: one row per flight, linking an airline to a source and destination airport.

Airline.name: Airline ID (foreign key)
Airline.description: Foreign key to airlines.uid; each of the 12 airlines has exactly 100 flights.

DestAirport.name: Destination airport code (foreign key)
DestAirport.description: Three-letter airport code of the destination, foreign key to airports.AirportCode; values carry a leading space.

FlightNo.name: Flight number
FlightNo.description: Airline flight number (integers 2-1535); not unique across the table, likely unique per airline.

SourceAirport.name: Source airport code (foreign key)
SourceAirport.description: Three-letter airport code of the origin, foreign key to airports.AirportCode; values carry a leading space.
